items.html: The reason for this is that, as explained, the aspect of the Nukva of Atik is made from the first five of the Keter of BON, in which there was never any nullification or flaw whatsoever, not even in the slightest. However, in AA, in his Nukva, the sorting of the kings began, for she was made from the last five of the Keter of BON, in which there was some flaw, and from there on the flaws kept increasing in the rest of the Partzufim, as mentioned there. Therefore, in the Reisha of Atik, where there was no flaw at all, the Bina in it was able to receive the upper light of AK that extends within the Reisha of Atik while it was there above. Therefore it too stood in the Reisha of Atik, and then the Daat, too, which is made from the union of HB, stands there as well.
